title.en: Two delivery targets: direct queue and topic fan-out
title.zh-CN: 两条投递路径：直接发往队列，或经主题扇出

description.en: A direct Send goes to the orders queue. A topic stores no messages; each matching subscription gets an independent backing-queue copy. Dead-lettered messages remain a state within their own queue.
description.zh-CN: 直接发送的消息进入 orders 队列。主题本身不存储消息，每个匹配订阅在独立支撑队列中获得副本。死信仍是各自队列内部的状态。

title.en: The message lifecycle: claims, settlement and recovery
title.zh-CN: 消息生命周期：领取、结算与恢复

description.en: The states scheduled, active, locked, deferred and dead_lettered belong to one queue. The diagram lists delivery counts, retries, renewal, expiry and removal conditions. Removed means row deletion, not another state.
description.zh-CN: scheduled、active、locked、deferred 和 dead_lettered 都属于同一队列。图中列出投递计数、重试、续锁、过期与删除条件；removed 表示行已删除，并非另一种消息状态。

title.en: Subscription filters: compile once, evaluate on publish
title.zh-CN: 订阅过滤：订阅时编译，发布时逐订阅执行

description.en: Subscribe compiles and type-checks the filter, caching the valid program or rejecting an invalid expression with HTTP 400. Publish evaluates the cached program for each subscription and creates a copy only when it matches.
description.zh-CN: Subscribe 编译并检查过滤表达式的类型，有效程序会被缓存，无效表达式返回 HTTP 400。Publish 按订阅执行已缓存的程序，仅在匹配时创建消息副本。
